newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asia Amalgamated unit withdraws ferry plan.
newsitem.headline: Asia Amalgamated unit withdraws ferry plan.

text.p: Marilag Transport Systems Inc, a unit of Asia Amalgamated Holdings Inc, said on Tuesday it had withdrawn its plan to operate a ferry service in Manila after a government agency refused to licence its imported ferries.

Marilag president Jaime Cabangis said the decision was made by its board of directors to avoid legal problems with the Maritime Industry Authority which invoked a law prohibiting foreign-made vessels from entering inland bays and rivers.

The company plans to have six ferries in its fleet. Two, costing a total of 18 million pesos, have already been delivered, while the remaining four will be delivered in December and January next year.
The passenger ferries will instead be used for its planned open seas services.
